plain.label: Open Plain
plain.blurb: Flat ground, nowhere to hide. Speed decides it.

hills.label: Rolling Hills
hills.blurb: Two ridges and a valley. Uphill is slow; height lends arrows reach.

river.label: River Crossing
river.blurb: Deep water. Three fords. Hold them or force them.

castle.label: Castle Approach
castle.blurb: A curtain wall, a gate, two narrow posterns. Engines break walls.
